mutmut 2.4 CLI, transcribed from the mutmut 2.x README / click definitions (NOT captured: mutmut 2 is not installed here).

  mutmut version                       (2.x has no --version flag; only this subcommand)
  mutmut run [options]
    --paths-to-mutate TEXT             comma-separated paths (files or directories) to mutate
    --tests-dir TEXT
    --runner TEXT
    --use-coverage
  mutmut results
  mutmut result-ids STATUS...          e.g. `mutmut result-ids skipped`
  mutmut junitxml [options]
    --suspicious-policy [ignore|skipped|error|failure]
    --untested-policy   [ignore|skipped|error|failure]
